nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender at deployment and changed via acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address written by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string, set to NECRO in the constructor.
Public token name string, set to 'Necroneum Token' in the constructor.
Public token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Internal _totalSupply accounting variable, credited entirely to the deployer address.
Mapping of holder address to token balance; written by transfer/transferFrom and read by balanceOf/totalSupply.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount of approved allowance; written by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance keying and allowance keying.
Owned() constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner); primary access-control gate.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: stages owner transfer in newOwner.
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, then promotes newOwner to owner.
NecromeunToken() constructor: initializes metadata, total supply and mints balances to a fixed address.
totalSupply() constant: returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with an unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant: returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no double-spend check.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits to.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): writes allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval externally.
Fallback function: payable, immediately reverts to refuse ETH.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: external ERC20 transfer of stray tokens to owner.
safeAdd(uint a, uint b): c = a + b with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
safeSub(uint a, uint b): require(b <= a) underflow guard then c = a - b.
safeMul(uint a, uint b): c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow guard.
safeDiv(uint a, uint b): require(b > 0) then c = a / b.
Untrusted external call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) performed after allowance state write.
Untrusted external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on a caller-supplied token contract.
Raw unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] performed without SafeMath.
